name: Currency
description: Converts money between the euro and 30 major currencies with the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, and tells you when a rate crosses a line. Nothing about you is sent.
author: Sidefolk

rate_crosses.title: Exchange rate
rate_crosses.description: Tells you once when an exchange rate goes above or below a line.

to.description: The currency it is priced in, like JPY.

above.description: Tell me when the rate goes above this.

below.description: Tell me when the rate goes below this.
